items.question: Trong câu "Disaster Recovery (DR) is the ability to restore systems and data after a serious incident.", từ "ability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disaster Recovery (DR) is the ability to restore systems and data after a serious incident.", what does "ability" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the power or skill to do something
items.explanation: ability /əˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): khả năng. "The ability to restore systems" = khả năng khôi phục hệ thống. Tính từ: able (có thể).
items.explanationEn: ability /əˈbɪl.ə.t̬i/ (noun): the power to do something. "The ability to restore systems" means being able to bring them back. Adjective: able.

items.question: Trong câu "Disaster Recovery (DR) is the ability to restore systems and data after a serious incident.", từ "restore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disaster Recovery (DR) is the ability to restore systems and data after a serious incident.", what does "restore" (verb) mean?
options: khôi phục, đưa trở lại trạng thái cũ
optionsEn: to bring back to a previous state
items.explanation: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (động từ): khôi phục. "Restore systems and data" = đưa hệ thống và dữ liệu trở lại hoạt động. Danh từ: restoration; "Backup & Restore" là tên một chiến lược DR.
items.explanationEn: restore /rɪˈstɔːr/ (verb): to bring something back to how it was. "Restore systems and data" means make them work again. "Backup & Restore" is a DR strategy name.

items.question: Trong câu "Disaster Recovery (DR) is the ability to restore systems and data after a serious incident.", từ "incident" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disaster Recovery (DR) is the ability to restore systems and data after a serious incident.", what does "incident" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incident /ˈɪn.sə.dənt/ (danh từ): sự cố. "A serious incident" = sự cố nghiêm trọng như mất AZ, lỗi phần cứng, tấn công mạng.
items.explanationEn: incident /ˈɪn.sə.dənt/ (noun): an unexpected, usually bad, event. "A serious incident" could be losing an AZ, a hardware failure or a cyberattack.

items.question: Trong câu "The goal is to bring the service back online with data loss and downtime kept within limits the business can accept.", từ "downtime" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal is to bring the service back online with data loss and downtime kept within limits the business can accept.", what does "downtime" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: time when a system is not working
items.explanation: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (danh từ): thời gian ngừng hoạt động. RTO đo "downtime" tối đa chấp nhận được. Trái nghĩa: uptime.
items.explanationEn: downtime /ˈdaʊn.taɪm/ (noun): the time a system is not available. RTO measures the maximum acceptable "downtime". Opposite: uptime.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS provides a purpose-built toolset for each data type and scenario.", từ "purpose-built" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS provides a purpose-built toolset for each data type and scenario.", what does "purpose-built" (adjective) mean?
options: được thiết kế riêng cho một mục đích
items.explanation: purpose-built /ˌpɝː.pəsˈbɪlt/ (tính từ): được xây dựng cho mục đích cụ thể. "Purpose-built toolset" = bộ công cụ thiết kế riêng cho từng loại dữ liệu và tình huống.
items.explanationEn: purpose-built /ˌpɝː.pəsˈbɪlt/ (adjective): made for one particular use. A "purpose-built toolset" has a tool designed for each data type and scenario.

items.question: Trong câu "The prompt states an RTO/RPO requirement or a budget, and you must pick the right DR strategy.", từ "prompt" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The prompt states an RTO/RPO requirement or a budget, and you must pick the right DR strategy.", what does "prompt" (noun) mean?
options: đề bài, nội dung câu hỏi
items.explanation: prompt /prɑːmpt/ (danh từ): đề bài. Trong thi cử, "the prompt" là phần mô tả tình huống/câu hỏi. Tính từ "prompt" còn nghĩa là nhanh chóng.
items.explanationEn: prompt /prɑːmpt/ (noun): the question text you respond to. In an exam, "the prompt" describes the scenario. As an adjective, "prompt" means quick.

items.question: Trong câu "The prompt states an RTO/RPO requirement or a budget, and you must pick the right DR strategy.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The prompt states an RTO/RPO requirement or a budget, and you must pick the right DR strategy.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
options: yêu cầu (điều bắt buộc phải đạt)
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪr.mənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu. "RTO/RPO requirement" = mức RTO/RPO bắt buộc phải đáp ứng. Động từ: require.
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪr.mənt/ (noun): something that is needed or must be met. An "RTO/RPO requirement" is the target that must be achieved. Verb: require.

items.question: Trong câu "The prompt states an RTO/RPO requirement or a budget, and you must pick the right DR strategy.", từ "budget" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The prompt states an RTO/RPO requirement or a budget, and you must pick the right DR strategy.", what does "budget" (noun) mean?
options: ngân sách (số tiền được phép chi)
optionsEn: the amount of money available to spend
items.explanation: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (danh từ): ngân sách. Ngân sách càng lớn thì có thể chọn chiến lược DR đắt hơn nhưng nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: budget /ˈbʌdʒ.ɪt/ (noun): the amount of money you can spend. A bigger budget allows a more expensive but faster DR strategy.

items.question: Trong câu "RPO vs RTO — the two core metrics.", từ "core" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RPO vs RTO — the two core metrics.", what does "core" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: core /kɔːr/ (tính từ): cốt lõi. "The two core metrics" = hai chỉ số quan trọng nhất. Danh từ "core" còn nghĩa là lõi (CPU core).
items.explanationEn: core /kɔːr/ (adjective): central and most important. "The two core metrics" are the two key measures. As a noun it also means a CPU core.

items.question: Trong câu "RPO vs RTO — the two core metrics.", từ "metrics" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RPO vs RTO — the two core metrics.", what does "metrics" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a measurement used to track something
items.explanation: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (danh từ): chỉ số đo lường. RPO và RTO là hai "metrics" dùng để đánh giá chiến lược DR.
items.explanationEn: metric /ˈmet.rɪk/ (noun): a measurement used to judge or track something. RPO and RTO are the two "metrics" for DR.

items.question: Trong câu "Every DR decision revolves around these two metrics.", cụm từ "revolves around" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every DR decision revolves around these two metrics.", what does the phrase "revolves around" mean?
optionsEn: to have something as its main focus
items.explanation: revolve around /rɪˈvɑːlv əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): xoay quanh. "Revolves around these two metrics" = mọi quyết định DR đều dựa trên hai chỉ số này.
items.explanationEn: revolve around /rɪˈvɑːlv əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to have something as the main focus. Every DR decision "revolves around" RPO and RTO.

items.question: Trong câu "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ɚ.ət.li/ (trạng từ): cố ý. "Deliberately swap" = cố tình tráo đổi. Trái nghĩa: accidentally.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ɚ.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately swap" means swap intentionally. Opposite: accidentally.

items.question: Trong câu "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to exchange one thing for another
items.explanation: swap /swɑːp/ (động từ): hoán đổi. Đề thi hay "swap" (tráo) định nghĩa RPO và RTO cho nhau. Trong IT còn có "swap memory".
items.explanationEn: swap /swɑːp/ (verb): to exchange one for the other. Exams "swap" the RPO and RTO definitions. IT also uses "swap memory".

items.question: Trong câu "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", từ "definitions" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", what does "definitions" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a statement of what something means
items.explanation: definition /ˌdef.əˈnɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): định nghĩa. "Definitions" ở đây là định nghĩa của RPO và RTO. Động từ: define.
items.explanationEn: definition /ˌdef.əˈnɪʃ.ən/ (noun): a statement of what a word or idea means. Here, the definitions of RPO and RTO. Verb: define.

items.question: Trong câu "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", cụm từ "trip you up" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exams often deliberately swap the definitions to trip you up.", what does the phrase "trip you up" mean?
optionsEn: to cause someone to make a mistake
to take someone on a trip
items.explanation: trip up /trɪp ʌp/ (cụm từ): làm vấp, làm mắc lỗi. "To trip you up" = để đánh lừa khiến bạn chọn sai.
items.explanationEn: trip up /trɪp ʌp/ (phrase): to make someone make a mistake. "To trip you up" means to trick you into a wrong answer.

items.question: Trong câu "RPO (Recovery Point Objective) — the maximum acceptable data loss, measured as how far back in time you go.", từ "measured" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RPO (Recovery Point Objective) — the maximum acceptable data loss, measured as how far back in time you go.", what does "measured" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find the size or amount of
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒ.ɚ/ (động từ): đo. "Measured as how far back in time you go" = RPO được đo bằng khoảng thời gian dữ liệu bị lùi lại. Danh từ: measurement.
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒ.ɚ/ (verb): to find the size or amount of something. RPO is "measured" as how far back in time your data goes. Noun: measurement.

items.question: Trong câu "RPO (Recovery Point Objective) — the maximum acceptable data loss, measured as how far back in time you go.", từ "acceptable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RPO (Recovery Point Objective) — the maximum acceptable data loss, measured as how far back in time you go.", what does "acceptable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chấp nhận được. "Maximum acceptable data loss" = lượng dữ liệu mất tối đa mà doanh nghiệp chấp nhận. Động từ: accept.
items.explanationEn: acceptable /əkˈsep.tə.bəl/ (adjective): good enough to be allowed. "Maximum acceptable data loss" is the most data loss the business will accept. Verb: accept.

items.question: Trong câu "If RPO = 1 hour, when disaster strikes you lose at most the last 1 hour of data.", từ "strikes" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If RPO = 1 hour, when disaster strikes you lose at most the last 1 hour of data.", what does "strikes" (verb) mean?
options: ập đến, xảy ra bất ngờ
optionsEn: to happen suddenly and cause damage
items.explanation: strike /straɪk/ (động từ): ập đến. "When disaster strikes" = khi thảm họa bất ngờ xảy ra. Lưu ý: "strike" còn nghĩa là đình công.
items.explanationEn: strike /straɪk/ (verb): to happen suddenly and cause harm. "When disaster strikes" means when a disaster suddenly happens. "Strike" can also mean a workers' protest.

items.question: Trong câu "A smaller RTO means more standby infrastructure is needed.", từ "standby" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A smaller RTO means more standby infrastructure is needed.", what does "standby" (adjective) mean?
options: dự phòng, sẵn sàng thay thế
optionsEn: ready to be used if needed
items.explanation: standby /ˈstænd.baɪ/ (tính từ): dự phòng. "Standby infrastructure" = hạ tầng chờ sẵn để thay thế khi hệ thống chính hỏng.
items.explanationEn: standby /ˈstænd.baɪ/ (adjective): kept ready for use when needed. "Standby infrastructure" waits to take over if the main system fails.

items.question: Trong câu "A bank sets RPO = 0 (no transaction may be lost) and RTO = a few seconds.", từ "transaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A bank sets RPO = 0 (no transaction may be lost) and RTO = a few seconds.", what does "transaction" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a single exchange, such as a payment
items.explanation: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (danh từ): giao dịch. Với ngân hàng, mỗi "transaction" (chuyển tiền, thanh toán) đều không được phép mất.
items.explanationEn: transaction /trænˈzæk.ʃən/ (noun): a single business exchange such as a payment. For a bank, no "transaction" can be lost.

items.question: Trong câu "The bank is forced into an expensive Active-Active architecture.", từ "forced" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The bank is forced into an expensive Active-Active architecture.", what does "forced" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make someone do something they must do
items.explanation: force /fɔːrs/ (động từ): buộc. "Is forced into an expensive architecture" = yêu cầu khắt khe khiến ngân hàng bắt buộc phải dùng kiến trúc đắt tiền.
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːrs/ (verb): to make someone do something with no choice. "Forced into an expensive architecture" means the bank has no cheaper option.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS defines four DR strategies, ordered by increasing cost and decreasing RTO/RPO.", từ "decreasing" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS defines four DR strategies, ordered by increasing cost and decreasing RTO/RPO.", what does "decreasing" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decrease /dɪˈkriːs/ (động từ): giảm. "Decreasing RTO/RPO" = RTO/RPO giảm dần. Trái nghĩa: increase (tăng).
items.explanationEn: decrease /dɪˈkriːs/ (verb): to become smaller. "Decreasing RTO/RPO" means RTO/RPO get lower. Opposite: increase.

items.question: Trong câu "Pilot Light keeps only the minimal core components running at all times.", từ "minimal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pilot Light keeps only the minimal core components running at all times.", what does "minimal" (adjective) mean?
options: tối thiểu, ít nhất có thể
items.explanation: minimal /ˈmɪn.ə.məl/ (tính từ): tối thiểu. "Minimal core components" = chỉ những thành phần lõi tối thiểu. Trái nghĩa: maximal.
items.explanationEn: minimal /ˈmɪn.ə.məl/ (adjective): as small as possible. "Minimal core components" means only the few essential parts. Opposite: maximal.

items.question: Trong câu "Typically a database is continuously replicated to the standby Region.", từ "continuously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Typically a database is continuously replicated to the standby Region.", what does "continuously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: continuously /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs.li/ (trạng từ): liên tục. "Continuously replicated" = dữ liệu được sao chép liên tục sang Region dự phòng. Tính từ: continuous.
items.explanationEn: continuously /kənˈtɪn.ju.əs.li/ (adverb): without stopping. "Continuously replicated" means data is copied to the standby Region all the time. Adjective: continuous.

items.question: Trong câu "During recovery, start/scale up the compute layer and route traffic over.", từ "layer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During recovery, start/scale up the compute layer and route traffic over.", what does "layer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a level in a system's structure
items.explanation: layer /ˈleɪ.ɚ/ (danh từ): tầng, lớp. "Compute layer" = tầng xử lý (EC2/ứng dụng) trong kiến trúc nhiều tầng.
items.explanationEn: layer /ˈleɪ.ɚ/ (noun): one level in a structure. The "compute layer" is the part of the architecture that runs the application.

items.question: Trong câu "During recovery, start/scale up the compute layer and route traffic over.", từ "route" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During recovery, start/scale up the compute layer and route traffic over.", what does "route" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to send along a chosen path
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (động từ): định tuyến. "Route traffic over" = chuyển hướng lưu lượng người dùng sang Region dự phòng. Phát âm Mỹ: /ruːt/ hoặc /raʊt/.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (verb): to send along a particular path. "Route traffic over" means direct users to the standby Region. US pronunciation: /ruːt/ or /raʊt/.

items.question: Trong câu "During recovery, start/scale up the compute layer and route traffic over.", từ "traffic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During recovery, start/scale up the compute layer and route traffic over.", what does "traffic" (noun) mean?
options: lưu lượng truy cập (request từ người dùng)
optionsEn: the requests and data moving through a network
items.explanation: traffic /ˈtræf.ɪk/ (danh từ): lưu lượng truy cập. Trong IT, "traffic" là lượng request/dữ liệu đi qua mạng, không phải giao thông.
items.explanationEn: traffic /ˈtræf.ɪk/ (noun): the flow of requests and data through a network. In IT it does not mean cars on the road.

items.question: Trong câu "A 'pilot light' always burns small, ready to flare up when needed.", cụm từ "pilot light" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A 'pilot light' always burns small, ready to flare up when needed.", what does the phrase "pilot light" mean?
options: ngọn lửa mồi (luôn cháy nhỏ để châm bếp/lò)
optionsEn: a small flame kept burning to light a heater
items.explanation: pilot light /ˈpaɪ.lət laɪt/ (cụm từ): ngọn lửa mồi. Chiến lược Pilot Light giống ngọn lửa nhỏ luôn cháy: chỉ phần lõi (database) chạy sẵn, cần thì "bùng" lên.
items.explanationEn: pilot light /ˈpaɪ.lət laɪt/ (phrase): a small flame always burning in a gas heater. The Pilot Light strategy keeps only the core (database) running, ready to grow when needed.

items.question: Trong câu "A 'pilot light' always burns small, ready to flare up when needed.", từ "burns" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A 'pilot light' always burns small, ready to flare up when needed.", what does "burns" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: burn /bɝːn/ (động từ): cháy. "Always burns small" = luôn cháy nhỏ, giống hệ thống lõi luôn chạy ở mức thấp.
items.explanationEn: burn /bɝːn/ (verb): to be on fire. "Always burns small" means a small flame is always on, like the core system running at a low level.

items.question: Trong câu "A 'pilot light' always burns small, ready to flare up when needed.", cụm từ "flare up" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A 'pilot light' always burns small, ready to flare up when needed.", what does the phrase "flare up" mean?
options: bùng lên, tăng mạnh đột ngột
optionsEn: to suddenly become bigger or stronger
items.explanation: flare up /fler ʌp/ (cụm từ): bùng lên. "Ready to flare up" = sẵn sàng bùng lên, tức mở rộng thành hệ thống đầy đủ khi có sự cố.
items.explanationEn: flare up /fler ʌp/ (phrase): to suddenly grow bigger or stronger. "Ready to flare up" means ready to expand into the full system during a disaster.

items.question: Trong câu "Warm Standby: a full but scaled-down copy of the production environment runs at all times in the standby Region.", từ "scaled-down" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Warm Standby: a full but scaled-down copy of the production environment runs at all times in the standby Region.", what does "scaled-down" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: scaled-down /ˌskeɪld ˈdaʊn/ (tính từ): thu nhỏ quy mô. "Scaled-down copy" = bản sao đầy đủ thành phần nhưng chạy với ít tài nguyên hơn. Trái nghĩa: scaled-up.
items.explanationEn: scaled-down /ˌskeɪld ˈdaʊn/ (adjective): made smaller in size. A "scaled-down copy" has every component but runs with fewer resources. Opposite: scaled-up.

items.question: Trong câu "Warm Standby: a full but scaled-down copy of the production environment runs at all times in the standby Region.", từ "production" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Warm Standby: a full but scaled-down copy of the production environment runs at all times in the standby Region.", what does "production" (noun) mean?
options: môi trường vận hành thật phục vụ người dùng
optionsEn: the live environment serving real users
items.explanation: production /prəˈdʌk.ʃən/ (danh từ): môi trường production. "Production environment" là hệ thống thật đang phục vụ người dùng, khác với môi trường dev/test.
items.explanationEn: production /prəˈdʌk.ʃən/ (noun): the live system used by real users. The "production environment" differs from development or test environments.

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-Site: a full production copy runs in parallel across 2+ Regions, all serving live traffic.", cụm từ "in parallel" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-Site: a full production copy runs in parallel across 2+ Regions, all serving live traffic.", what does the phrase "in parallel" mean?
items.explanation: in parallel /ɪn ˈper.ə.lel/ (cụm từ): song song. "Runs in parallel across 2+ Regions" = chạy đồng thời ở nhiều Region.
items.explanationEn: in parallel /ɪn ˈper.ə.lel/ (phrase): at the same time. "Runs in parallel across 2+ Regions" means it runs simultaneously in several Regions.

items.question: Trong câu "RTO and RPO are near zero — if one Region dies, the other takes over instantly.", cụm từ "takes over" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RTO and RPO are near zero — if one Region dies, the other takes over instantly.", what does the phrase "takes over" mean?
optionsEn: to start doing a job in place of another
items.explanation: take over /teɪk ˈoʊ.vɚ/ (cụm từ): tiếp quản. "The other takes over" = Region còn lại đảm nhận toàn bộ lưu lượng thay cho Region bị hỏng.
items.explanationEn: take over /teɪk ˈoʊ.vɚ/ (phrase): to take responsibility in place of someone else. "The other takes over" means the other Region handles all traffic.

items.question: Trong câu "RTO and RPO are near zero — if one Region dies, the other takes over instantly.", từ "instantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RTO and RPO are near zero — if one Region dies, the other takes over instantly.", what does "instantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Takes over instantly" = tiếp quản gần như không có độ trễ. Tính từ: instant.
items.explanationEn: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (adverb): immediately. "Takes over instantly" means with almost no delay. Adjective: instant.

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-Site is the most expensive, since you maintain double (or more) of the entire infrastructure.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-Site is the most expensive, since you maintain double (or more) of the entire infrastructure.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
options: duy trì, vận hành liên tục
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì. "Maintain double the infrastructure" = luôn duy trì gấp đôi hạ tầng. Danh từ: maintenance (bảo trì).
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep something running over time. "Maintain double the infrastructure" means keeping two full copies running. Noun: maintenance.

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-Site is the most expensive, since you maintain double (or more) of the entire infrastructure.", từ "double" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-Site is the most expensive, since you maintain double (or more) of the entire infrastructure.", what does "double" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (danh từ): gấp đôi. "Double the infrastructure" = lượng hạ tầng gấp hai lần, nên chi phí cũng cao.
items.explanationEn: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (noun): twice the amount. "Double the infrastructure" means two times as much infrastructure, so it costs more.

items.question: Trong câu "Order to memorize: Backup & Restore < Pilot Light < Warm Standby < Multi-Site.", từ "memorize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Order to memorize: Backup & Restore < Pilot Light < Warm Standby < Multi-Site.", what does "memorize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: memorize /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (động từ): ghi nhớ thuộc lòng. "Order to memorize" = thứ tự cần học thuộc. Danh từ: memory.
items.explanationEn: memorize /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (verb): to learn something so you remember it exactly. "Order to memorize" is the order to learn by heart. Noun: memory.

items.question: Trong câu "Backup & Restore < Pilot Light < Warm Standby < Multi-Site — cost rises, RTO/RPO falls.", từ "rises" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backup & Restore < Pilot Light < Warm Standby < Multi-Site — cost rises, RTO/RPO falls.", what does "rises" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: rise /raɪz/ (động từ): tăng lên. "Cost rises, RTO/RPO falls" = chi phí tăng, RTO/RPO giảm. Trái nghĩa: fall.
items.explanationEn: rise /raɪz/ (verb): to go up. "Cost rises, RTO/RPO falls" means cost goes up while RTO/RPO go down. Opposite: fall.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS DMS migrates databases with minimal downtime — the source stays fully operational during migration.", từ "operational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS DMS migrates databases with minimal downtime — the source stays fully operational during migration.", what does "operational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: operational /ˌɑː.pəˈreɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): đang hoạt động. "The source stays fully operational" = database nguồn vẫn chạy bình thường trong lúc chuyển.
items.explanationEn: operational /ˌɑː.pəˈreɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): working and able to be used. "The source stays fully operational" means the source database keeps running during migration.

items.question: Trong câu "DMS supports homogeneous migration (same engine, e.g. Oracle → Oracle).", từ "homogeneous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DMS supports homogeneous migration (same engine, e.g. Oracle → Oracle).", what does "homogeneous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: homogeneous /ˌhoʊ.moʊˈdʒiː.ni.əs/ (tính từ): đồng nhất. "Homogeneous migration" = chuyển giữa hai database cùng engine. Trái nghĩa: heterogeneous.
items.explanationEn: homogeneous /ˌhoʊ.moʊˈdʒiː.ni.əs/ (adjective): of the same kind. A "homogeneous migration" moves data between the same database engine. Opposite: heterogeneous.

items.question: Trong câu "DMS also supports heterogeneous migration (different engine, e.g. Oracle → PostgreSQL).", từ "heterogeneous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DMS also supports heterogeneous migration (different engine, e.g. Oracle → PostgreSQL).", what does "heterogeneous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: heterogeneous /ˌhet̬.ɚ.oʊˈdʒiː.ni.əs/ (tính từ): không đồng nhất. "Heterogeneous migration" = chuyển giữa các engine khác nhau, cần thêm SCT để chuyển schema.
items.explanationEn: heterogeneous /ˌhet̬.ɚ.oʊˈdʒiː.ni.əs/ (adjective): made up of different kinds. A "heterogeneous migration" changes engines and needs SCT to convert the schema.

items.question: Trong câu "DMS supports homogeneous migration (same engine, e.g. Oracle → Oracle).", từ "engine" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DMS supports homogeneous migration (same engine, e.g. Oracle → Oracle).", what does "engine" (noun) mean?
options: hệ quản trị cơ sở dữ liệu (phần mềm lõi xử lý dữ liệu)
optionsEn: the core database software, e.g. MySQL or Oracle
items.explanation: engine /ˈen.dʒɪn/ (danh từ): engine cơ sở dữ liệu. "Same engine" = cùng loại phần mềm database (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL...), không phải động cơ.
items.explanationEn: engine /ˈen.dʒɪn/ (noun): the core software that runs a database, such as Oracle or MySQL. It does not mean a motor here.

items.question: Trong câu "DMS supports CDC (Change Data Capture) — it keeps replicating ongoing changes, enabling cutover with very low RPO.", từ "ongoing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DMS supports CDC (Change Data Capture) — it keeps replicating ongoing changes, enabling cutover with very low RPO.", what does "ongoing" (adjective) mean?
options: đang diễn ra, tiếp tục phát sinh
items.explanation: ongoing /ˈɑːn.ɡoʊ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): đang diễn ra. "Ongoing changes" = những thay đổi liên tục phát sinh trên database nguồn trong lúc migration.
items.explanationEn: ongoing /ˈɑːn.ɡoʊ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): continuing to happen. "Ongoing changes" are new changes still being made to the source database during migration.

items.question: Trong câu "DMS keeps replicating ongoing changes, enabling cutover with very low RPO.", từ "cutover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DMS keeps replicating ongoing changes, enabling cutover with very low RPO.", what does "cutover" (noun) mean?
options: thời điểm chuyển hẳn sang hệ thống mới
optionsEn: the switch from the old system to the new one
items.explanation: cutover /ˈkʌt̬ˌoʊ.vɚ/ (danh từ): cutover: bước chuyển đổi cuối cùng, khi người dùng được chuyển từ hệ thống cũ sang hệ thống mới.
items.explanationEn: cutover /ˈkʌt̬ˌoʊ.vɚ/ (noun): the final switch when users move from the old system to the new system.

items.question: Trong câu "When changing engines, pair DMS with SCT (Schema Conversion Tool) to convert the schema first.", từ "pair" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When changing engines, pair DMS with SCT (Schema Conversion Tool) to convert the schema first.", what does "pair" (verb) mean?
options: ghép cặp, kết hợp dùng cùng
optionsEn: to use together as a pair
items.explanation: pair /per/ (động từ): ghép cặp. "Pair it with SCT" = dùng DMS kèm với SCT. Danh từ: pair (một cặp).
items.explanationEn: pair /per/ (verb): to put two things together. "Pair it with SCT" means use DMS together with SCT. Noun: a pair.

items.question: Trong câu "Pair DMS with SCT to convert schema/stored procedures/code first, then DMS moves the data.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pair DMS with SCT to convert schema/stored procedures/code first, then DMS moves the data.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change into a different form
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɝːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. "Convert schema" = chuyển cấu trúc database sang định dạng của engine mới. Danh từ: conversion.
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɝːt/ (verb): to change into another form. "Convert schema" means rewrite the database structure for the new engine. Noun: conversion.

items.question: Trong câu "Pair DMS with SCT to convert schema/stored procedures/code first, then DMS moves the data.", cụm từ "stored procedures" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pair DMS with SCT to convert schema/stored procedures/code first, then DMS moves the data.", what does the phrase "stored procedures" mean?
options: thủ tục lưu sẵn (đoạn mã SQL lưu trong database)
optionsEn: saved SQL code that runs inside the database
items.explanation: stored procedure /stɔːrd prəˈsiː.dʒɚ/ (cụm từ): thủ tục lưu sẵn. "Stored procedures" là các đoạn mã SQL được lưu và chạy trong database; khi đổi engine phải chuyển đổi chúng.
items.explanationEn: stored procedure /stɔːrd prəˈsiː.dʒɚ/ (phrase): blocks of SQL code saved and run inside a database. They must be converted when changing engines.

items.question: Trong câu "MGN is the current standard lift-and-shift (rehost) tool: move whole servers to EC2 without rewriting the application.", cụm từ "lift-and-shift" nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MGN is the current standard lift-and-shift (rehost) tool: move whole servers to EC2 without rewriting the application.", what does the phrase "lift-and-shift" mean?
options: viết lại toàn bộ ứng dụng
chuyển nguyên trạng, không sửa ứng dụng
optionsEn: moving as-is without changing the app
items.explanation: lift-and-shift /ˌlɪft ənd ˈʃɪft/ (cụm từ): chuyển nguyên trạng. "Lift-and-shift" = nhấc lên và đặt sang cloud, giữ nguyên ứng dụng (còn gọi là rehost).
items.explanationEn: lift-and-shift /ˌlɪft ənd ˈʃɪft/ (phrase): moving an application to the cloud as it is, without changes (also called rehost).

items.question: Trong câu "MGN moves whole physical/virtual servers to EC2 without rewriting the application.", từ "rewriting" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MGN moves whole physical/virtual servers to EC2 without rewriting the application.", what does "rewriting" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to write again in a new way
items.explanation: rewrite /riːˈraɪt/ (động từ): viết lại. Tiền tố "re-" nghĩa là làm lại: write → rewrite. "Without rewriting the application" = không phải sửa mã.
items.explanationEn: rewrite /riːˈraɪt/ (verb): to write again. The prefix "re-" means again. "Without rewriting the application" means no code changes.

items.question: Trong câu "DataSync transfers and synchronizes data online between on-premises (NFS/SMB/HDFS) and AWS storage services.", từ "synchronizes" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DataSync transfers and synchronizes data online between on-premises (NFS/SMB/HDFS) and AWS storage services.", what does "synchronizes" (verb) mean?
options: đồng bộ hóa (làm cho hai bên giống nhau)
optionsEn: to make two places hold the same data
items.explanation: synchronize /ˈsɪŋ.krə.naɪz/ (động từ): đồng bộ hóa. "Synchronizes data" = làm cho dữ liệu hai nơi giống nhau. Viết tắt: sync.
items.explanationEn: synchronize /ˈsɪŋ.krə.naɪz/ (verb): to make data the same in two places. Short form: sync.

items.question: Trong câu "DataSync is automated, with encryption and integrity checks.", từ "integrity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DataSync is automated, with encryption and integrity checks.", what does "integrity" (noun) mean?
options: tính toàn vẹn (dữ liệu không bị sai/hỏng)
items.explanation: integrity /ɪnˈteɡ.rə.t̬i/ (danh từ): tính toàn vẹn. "Integrity checks" = kiểm tra dữ liệu đến nơi không bị hỏng hay thay đổi. Nghĩa khác: sự chính trực.
items.explanationEn: integrity /ɪnˈteɡ.rə.t̬i/ (noun): being whole and not corrupted. "Integrity checks" confirm data arrived unchanged. It also means honesty in people.

items.question: Trong câu "Snow Family: offline bulk migration using physical devices for very large data / weak network.", từ "weak" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Snow Family: offline bulk migration using physical devices for very large data / weak network.", what does "weak" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: weak /wiːk/ (tính từ): yếu. "Weak network" = mạng chậm/không đủ băng thông để truyền dữ liệu lớn. Trái nghĩa: strong.
items.explanationEn: weak /wiːk/ (adjective): not strong. A "weak network" is too slow for large transfers. Opposite: strong.

items.question: Trong câu "Storage Gateway provides hybrid connectivity that lets on-premises applications use AWS storage as if it were local.", từ "connectivity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Storage Gateway provides hybrid connectivity that lets on-premises applications use AWS storage as if it were local.", what does "connectivity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: connectivity /ˌkɑː.nekˈtɪv.ə.t̬i/ (danh từ): khả năng kết nối. "Hybrid connectivity" = kết nối giữa on-premises và AWS. Động từ: connect.
items.explanationEn: connectivity /ˌkɑː.nekˈtɪv.ə.t̬i/ (noun): the state or ability of being connected. "Hybrid connectivity" links on-premises systems with AWS. Verb: connect.

items.question: Trong câu "Storage Gateway lets on-premises applications use AWS storage as if it were local.", từ "as if" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Storage Gateway lets on-premises applications use AWS storage as if it were local.", what does "as if" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: as if /æz ɪf/ (liên từ): như thể. "As if it were local" = ứng dụng dùng S3 cứ như là ổ đĩa tại chỗ, dù thực tế dữ liệu ở AWS.
items.explanationEn: as if /æz ɪf/ (conjunction): in a way that makes it seem that. "As if it were local" means apps use it like local storage, though it is really on AWS.

items.question: Trong câu "When planning how to move each application to the cloud, AWS classifies the approach into seven options.", từ "classifies" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When planning how to move each application to the cloud, AWS classifies the approach into seven options.", what does "classifies" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæs.ə.faɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. "Classifies the approach into seven options" = chia cách tiếp cận thành 7 loại. Danh từ: classification.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæs.ə.faɪ/ (verb): to put things into groups. "Classifies the approach into seven options" means sorts it into seven types. Noun: classification.

items.question: Trong câu "When planning how to move each application to the cloud, AWS classifies the approach into seven options.", từ "approach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When planning how to move each application to the cloud, AWS classifies the approach into seven options.", what does "approach" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way of dealing with something
items.explanation: approach /əˈproʊtʃ/ (danh từ): cách tiếp cận. "The approach" = cách thức di chuyển ứng dụng lên cloud. Động từ "approach" còn nghĩa là tiến lại gần.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈproʊtʃ/ (noun): a way of dealing with a task. "The approach" is how you move each app to the cloud. As a verb it means to come closer.

items.question: Trong câu "Replatform — 'lift-tinker-and-shift', light optimization.", từ "tinker" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Replatform — 'lift-tinker-and-shift', light optimization.", what does "tinker" (verb) mean?
options: chỉnh sửa nhỏ, mày mò điều chỉnh
optionsEn: to make small changes or adjustments
items.explanation: tinker /ˈtɪŋ.kɚ/ (động từ): chỉnh sửa nhỏ. "Lift-tinker-and-shift" = chuyển lên cloud kèm vài thay đổi nhỏ (ví dụ chuyển DB sang RDS).
items.explanationEn: tinker /ˈtɪŋ.kɚ/ (verb): to make small changes to improve something. "Lift-tinker-and-shift" means moving with a few small tweaks, such as moving the DB to RDS.

items.question: Trong câu "Repurchase — drop the old system and buy a replacement SaaS solution.", từ "replacement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Repurchase — drop the old system and buy a replacement SaaS solution.", what does "replacement" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: something that takes the place of another
items.explanation: replacement /rɪˈpleɪs.mənt/ (danh từ): sự/thứ thay thế. "A replacement SaaS solution" = một sản phẩm SaaS dùng thay cho hệ thống cũ. Động từ: replace.
items.explanationEn: replacement /rɪˈpleɪs.mənt/ (noun): something that takes the place of another. "A replacement SaaS solution" is a SaaS product used instead of the old system. Verb: replace.

items.question: Trong câu "Repurchase — drop the old system and buy a replacement SaaS solution.", từ "drop" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Repurchase — drop the old system and buy a replacement SaaS solution.", what does "drop" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drop /drɑːp/ (động từ): bỏ. "Drop the old system" = từ bỏ hệ thống cũ. Nghĩa gốc: làm rơi; trong SQL, DROP TABLE = xóa bảng.
items.explanationEn: drop /drɑːp/ (verb): to stop using or give up. "Drop the old system" means abandon it. In SQL, DROP TABLE deletes a table.

items.question: Trong câu "Refactor / Re-architect — rewrite in a cloud-native architecture (serverless, microservices) to fully exploit the cloud.", từ "exploit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refactor / Re-architect — rewrite in a cloud-native architecture (serverless, microservices) to fully exploit the cloud.", what does "exploit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (động từ): tận dụng. "Fully exploit the cloud" = khai thác tối đa lợi ích của cloud. Trong bảo mật, "exploit" còn nghĩa là khai thác lỗ hổng.
items.explanationEn: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (verb): to use something fully to gain benefit. "Fully exploit the cloud" means get every benefit from it. In security, "exploit" also means attacking a weakness.

items.question: Trong câu "Refactor / Re-architect — rewrite in a cloud-native architecture (serverless, microservices) to fully exploit the cloud.", từ "cloud-native" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refactor / Re-architect — rewrite in a cloud-native architecture (serverless, microservices) to fully exploit the cloud.", what does "cloud-native" (adjective) mean?
options: chỉ chạy trên máy tính cá nhân
được thiết kế riêng để chạy trên cloud
do nhà cung cấp bản địa làm
optionsEn: running only on a personal computer
designed specifically to run in the cloud
items.explanation: cloud-native /ˌklaʊd ˈneɪ.t̬ɪv/ (tính từ): thuần cloud. "Cloud-native architecture" = kiến trúc xây dựng từ đầu cho cloud như serverless, microservices.
items.explanationEn: cloud-native /ˌklaʊd ˈneɪ.t̬ɪv/ (adjective): built from the start to run in the cloud, such as serverless and microservices.

items.question: Trong câu "Retire — decommission applications that are no longer needed.", từ "decommission" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retire — decommission applications that are no longer needed.", what does "decommission" (verb) mean?
options: cho ngừng hoạt động, gỡ bỏ khỏi vận hành
optionsEn: to officially take out of service
items.explanation: decommission /ˌdiː.kəˈmɪʃ.ən/ (động từ): cho ngừng hoạt động. "Decommission applications" = tắt và gỡ bỏ các ứng dụng không còn cần.
items.explanationEn: decommission /ˌdiː.kəˈmɪʃ.ən/ (verb): to officially stop using and remove from service. "Decommission applications" means shut down apps that are no longer needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Retain — keep it on-premises (not migrated yet, or not at all), e.g. due to compliance constraints.", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retain — keep it on-premises (not migrated yet, or not at all), e.g. due to compliance constraints.", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): giữ lại. Chiến lược "Retain" = giữ ứng dụng ở on-premises. Danh từ: retention.
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep. The "Retain" strategy leaves the app on-premises. Noun: retention.

items.question: Trong câu "Retain — keep it on-premises (not migrated yet, or not at all), e.g. due to compliance constraints.", từ "constraints" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retain — keep it on-premises (not migrated yet, or not at all), e.g. due to compliance constraints.", what does "constraints" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc. "Compliance constraints" = các hạn chế do quy định pháp lý khiến chưa thể chuyển lên cloud.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. "Compliance constraints" are legal rules that stop a move to the cloud.

items.question: Trong câu "Relocate — move a whole infrastructure cluster (e.g. VMware) to the cloud without repurchasing or rewriting.", từ "relocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relocate — move a whole infrastructure cluster (e.g. VMware) to the cloud without repurchasing or rewriting.", what does "relocate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move to a new place
items.explanation: relocate /riːˈloʊ.keɪt/ (động từ): di dời. Chiến lược "Relocate" = chuyển nguyên cụm hạ tầng (như VMware) sang cloud. Danh từ: relocation.
items.explanationEn: relocate /riːˈloʊ.keɪt/ (verb): to move to a new place. The "Relocate" strategy moves a whole cluster, such as VMware, to the cloud. Noun: relocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Relocate — move a whole infrastructure cluster (e.g. VMware) to the cloud without repurchasing or rewriting.", từ "cluster" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relocate — move a whole infrastructure cluster (e.g. VMware) to the cloud without repurchasing or rewriting.", what does "cluster" (noun) mean?
options: cụm (nhóm máy chủ hoạt động cùng nhau)
optionsEn: a group of servers working together
items.explanation: cluster /ˈklʌs.tɚ/ (danh từ): cụm. "Infrastructure cluster" = nhóm máy chủ được quản lý và vận hành chung như một hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: cluster /ˈklʌs.tɚ/ (noun): a group of servers that work together as one system.

items.question: Trong câu "Relocate — move a whole infrastructure cluster (e.g. VMware) to the cloud without repurchasing or rewriting.", từ "repurchasing" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relocate — move a whole infrastructure cluster (e.g. VMware) to the cloud without repurchasing or rewriting.", what does "repurchasing" (verb) mean?
options: mua lại (mua sản phẩm/bản quyền mới)
optionsEn: to buy again or buy a new product
items.explanation: repurchase /riːˈpɝː.tʃəs/ (động từ): mua lại. "Without repurchasing" = không phải mua sản phẩm/bản quyền mới. "Repurchase" cũng là tên một chiến lược trong 7 Rs.
items.explanationEn: repurchase /riːˈpɝː.tʃəs/ (verb): to buy again. "Without repurchasing" means no need to buy new products or licences. It is also one of the 7 Rs.

items.question: Trong câu "The smaller the required RTO/RPO and the larger the budget, the further right the strategy you pick.", từ "further" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The smaller the required RTO/RPO and the larger the budget, the further right the strategy you pick.", what does "further" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: further /ˈfɝː.ðɚ/ (trạng từ): xa hơn. "The further right" = càng về bên phải của dãy chiến lược (đắt hơn, nhanh hơn). Cấu trúc "the ...er, the ...er" = càng... càng...
items.explanationEn: further /ˈfɝː.ðɚ/ (adverb): at a greater distance. "The further right" means further along the list towards faster, costlier strategies. "The ...er, the ...er" means "the more..., the more...".

items.question: Trong câu "Pilot Light vs Warm Standby: this is the most commonly confused pair.", từ "confused" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pilot Light vs Warm Standby: this is the most commonly confused pair.", what does "confused" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: confused /kənˈfjuːzd/ (tính từ): bị nhầm lẫn. "The most commonly confused pair" = cặp khái niệm hay bị nhầm với nhau nhất. Động từ: confuse.
items.explanationEn: confused /kənˈfjuːzd/ (adjective): mixed up, mistaken for each other. "The most commonly confused pair" is the pair people mix up most. Verb: confuse.

items.question: Trong câu "Pilot Light vs Warm Standby: this is the most commonly confused pair.", từ "commonly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pilot Light vs Warm Standby: this is the most commonly confused pair.", what does "commonly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: commonly /ˈkɑː.mən.li/ (trạng từ): thường, phổ biến. "Most commonly confused" = bị nhầm nhiều nhất. Tính từ: common.
items.explanationEn: commonly /ˈkɑː.mən.li/ (adverb): usually, by many people. "Most commonly confused" means mixed up most often. Adjective: common.

items.question: Trong câu "DR ensures systems recover from disaster within acceptable RPO (max data loss) and RTO (max downtime).", từ "ensures" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DR ensures systems recover from disaster within acceptable RPO (max data loss) and RTO (max downtime).", what does "ensures" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊr/ (động từ): đảm bảo. "DR ensures systems recover" = DR đảm bảo hệ thống phục hồi được. Đừng nhầm với insure (mua bảo hiểm).
items.explanationEn: ensure /ɪnˈʃʊr/ (verb): to make certain that something happens. "DR ensures systems recover" means it makes sure they recover. Do not confuse it with "insure".

items.question: Trong câu "AWS DMS (with SCT when engines differ) migrates databases with no interruption.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS DMS (with SCT when engines differ) migrates databases with no interruption.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ɚ/ (động từ): khác nhau. "When engines differ" = khi hai engine database khác nhau. Tính từ: different.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ɚ/ (verb): to be different. "When engines differ" means the source and target engines are not the same. Adjective: different.

items.question: Trong câu "AWS DMS (with SCT when engines differ) migrates databases with no interruption.", từ "interruption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AWS DMS (with SCT when engines differ) migrates databases with no interruption.", what does "interruption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interruption /ˌɪn.t̬əˈrʌp.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự gián đoạn. "With no interruption" = không làm dịch vụ bị ngắt quãng. Động từ: interrupt.
items.explanationEn: interruption /ˌɪn.t̬əˈrʌp.ʃən/ (noun): a stop or break in something that is happening. "With no interruption" means the service keeps running. Verb: interrupt.

items.question: Trong câu "DataSync, Snow Family, Storage Gateway and AWS Backup serve different data transfer and protection needs.", từ "protection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "DataSync, Snow Family, Storage Gateway and AWS Backup serve different data transfer and protection needs.", what does "protection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: protection /prəˈtek.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự bảo vệ. "Data protection" = bảo vệ dữ liệu khỏi mất mát (ví dụ bằng sao lưu). Động từ: protect.
items.explanationEn: protection /prəˈtek.ʃən/ (noun): keeping something safe from harm. "Data protection" keeps data from being lost, for example by backups. Verb: protect.

items.question: Trong câu "The 7 Rs are the framework for classifying per-application migration strategies.", từ "framework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The 7 Rs are the framework for classifying per-application migration strategies.", what does "framework" (noun) mean?
options: khung phương pháp, bộ nguyên tắc có cấu trúc
optionsEn: a structured set of ideas used as a guide
items.explanation: framework /ˈfreɪm.wɝːk/ (danh từ): khung. "Framework" ở đây là bộ khung tư duy để phân loại chiến lược; trong lập trình còn chỉ bộ thư viện như React.
items.explanationEn: framework /ˈfreɪm.wɝːk/ (noun): a structure of ideas used to guide decisions. In programming it can also mean a library base such as React.

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-Site / Active-Active gives near-zero RTO & RPO but is the most expensive.", từ "near-zero" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-Site / Active-Active gives near-zero RTO & RPO but is the most expensive.", what does "near-zero" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: near-zero /ˌnɪr ˈzɪr.oʊ/ (tính từ): gần như bằng không. "Near-zero RTO & RPO" = hầu như không mất thời gian khôi phục và không mất dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: near-zero /ˌnɪr ˈzɪr.oʊ/ (adjective): almost nothing. "Near-zero RTO & RPO" means almost no downtime and almost no data loss.
